system.description:
At 18th level, you gain the following abilities:

Compulsory Action

You learn the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.a64cea2ij2t33xva]{Geas} and may cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot. Intelligence is your spellcasting modifier for this spell.

Disorienting Fey Aspect

When you activate your @UUID[Compendium.out-of-the-wilds.features.Item.ejxRIQLhEeTcwDNQ]{Fey Aspect} ability, you create three duplicates of yourself instead of one. When one of these duplicates is destroyed, the creature that destroyed it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw versus your maneuver DC or become confused for the next minute. Creatures may repeat this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

Ear for Deceit

You have advantage on Insight checks made to determine if a creature is lying to you. You may always choose to use Intelligence when making these checks.

effects.name: Confused
effects.description:
• A confused creature can't take reactions.

  • On its turn a confused creature rolls a [[/r 1d8]] to determine what it does.

    • On a 1 to 4, a confused creature does nothing.

    • On a 5 or 6, a confused creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction.

    • On a 7 or 8, a confused creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.
